record.title: South African Beitbridge cargo admission suspension for COVID disinfection July 2020
record.scope: South African customs admission at Beitbridge
record.direction: Both directions for new cargo admission.
record.movement: New commercial trucks from both sides
record.exceptions: Trucks already inside could be processed out; wider passenger restrictions remained.
record.enforcement: SARS notice halted entry into the customs yard.
record.consequences: Queues; subsequent report describes cargo clearance.
record.relationship: Local cargo-specific interruption within national South African COVID controls; not a second general passenger regime.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Prevent further infection after a customs employee tested positive.
record.context: Intentional instruction barred new cargo admission while the yard was disinfected. This meets the intentional personnel-protection closure scope rather than an unexplained technical outage.
record.uncertainty: Later report says Wednesday 8 July afternoon, whereas a page dated 8 July describes prior-day queues. Start retained at month precision pending reconciliation. SARS notice is shared across outlets; reopening is the border reporter’s follow-up, not a second independent official chronology.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Reported operational restoration on 10 July; exact start withheld.
